rationale: M49 W13: the member-segment dedup key was `${source}.${seg}`, and a private segment's text is literally `#x` — so the key became `${source}.#` + `x`, byte-identical to the bare-read/chain-root key of the plain identifier `x` (`${source}.#` + `x`). Whichever node was walked first claimed it. Measured on the svelte corpus: `packages/svelte/src/reactivity/set.js` — the field initializer `#update_version = update_version || -1` (line 52) reads the IMPORTED binding `update_version` first, claiming key `SvelteSet.#update_version`, so the genuine read `this.#update_version` (line 88) was dropped as a duplicate: the first javascript-lane MISSING edge W12's 400-file measurement registered. `#version`/`#size` survived only because no plain binding of those names is read in the same container, which is why the defect hid from every fixture. Contract: a private member read emits the `#`-spelled target; a same-named bare read emits its own edge; neither suppresses the other.
